tools.name: wafermap_resources
tools.description: Lists Wafermap's pay-per-call resources (38 of its own) and the live Inference Marketplace listings (ids "m/<name>", run and paid directly to their seller, provider "community") with id, name, category, USD price and a one-line summary. Use it first to find the right resource id; then read its input

tools.name: wafermap_resource_schema
tools.description: Returns everything needed to call one Wafermap resource: its USD price, the JSON Schema of its input, a ready-to-use example input, what it returns, and its HTTP endpoint. Use it after wafermap_resources and before wafermap_call so the input is valid (invalid input is rejected before any payment). F

tools.name: wafermap_call
tools.description: Runs one Wafermap resource and pays its exact USD price over x402, in USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Arc or Soneium. tools.name: wafermap_discover
tools.description: Searches the open x402 Bazaar index (run by Coinbase CDP) for paid APIs outside Wafermap's own catalog, such as weather, web search, data enrichment or token prices. tools.name: wafermap_tokens
tools.description: Lists the tokens a Wafermap wallet can swap through the KyberSwap aggregator on one network, with symbol, name and contract address. On Robinhood Chain this includes ETH, WETH, USDG and every Robinhood stock token (TSLA, NVDA, AAPL…); on Base it includes ETH, WETH and USDC. Use it to resolve a ticke

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wafermap_discover · Private data: wafermap_resources, wafermap_call, wafermap_discover, wafermap_tokens · Public sink: wafermap_call · Destructive: wafermap_resources, wafermap_discover.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wafermap_discover · Private data: wafermap_resources, wafermap_call, wafermap_discover, wafermap_tokens · Public sink: wafermap_call · Destructive: wafermap_resources, wafermap_discover

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "wafermap_resources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
